title: Arena: A General Evaluation Platform and Building Toolkit for Multi-Agent Intelligence
reasoning: The paper introduces a general evaluation platform and building toolkit for multi-agent intelligence. It discusses social structures and reward schemes that define cooperative and competitive relationships among agents, which could be distantly related to social norms. However, it does not directly evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component. Its focus is on AI agent behavior in simulated environments.
